title: Escape Delimiter Collision
statement: Read a block of user content that might itself contain the delimiter '```'. Print the content wrapped in a delimiter that's guaranteed not to collide: use '~~~~' instead of '```' if the content contains '```', otherwise use '```' as normal.
starter_code:
content = input()
# TODO: pick '~~~~' if '```' is in content, else '```', and wrap the content in it
hints: Check membership of the triple-backtick substring first to choose a safe delimiter
